Kitchen Remodeling

MJ Kitchen & Bath can design and install your whole updated kitchen, including cabinetry, counter tops, tile, sinks, lighting and flooring. Bring in your ideas – our talented kitchen design team can help you get a custom look you’ll love!

Bathroom Remodeling

Whether you’re dreaming of a relaxing retreat or need a functional update, we can bring your vision to life with a complete bathroom remodel. Our team will help you make the most of your space, choose finishes and pull the details together for a beautiful result.

Cabinetry & More

Top quality semi-custom and custom cabinetry from Wood-Mode, Showplace, and Pioneer, featuring a variety of contemporary, transitional and traditional styles in a range of easy-care materials, rich wood grains, and stained and painted finishes.

View Our Work

Our project portfolio showcases how cabinets can be used throughout the house: kitchen cabinets, kitchen islands, butler’s pantries, wet bars and coffee bars, bathroom vanities, mud rooms, entertainment centers, laundry rooms and more.

KITCHEN REMODELING, BATH REMODELING, DESIGN, CABINETRY
Our Expertise. Your Sensational Kitchen.

Beautiful. Functional. Enduring.

MJ Kitchen & Bath provides complete kitchen remodeling and bathroom remodeling services in Plymouth, Canton, Northville, Ann Arbor and the surrounding Metro Detroit communities.

We work with homeowners, as well as interior designers and builders to create amazing spaces.

Kitchen Design Specialists

You’ll work closely with our Design Team to create a kitchen or bath that includes your “wish list,” as well as our recommendations for design details and popular features for function, storage and organization that take your project to the next level.

Home Remodeling Experts
Sit back and relax as our Project Team manages your remodel from start to finish. Our friendly, experienced crews will treat your home with respect, and will handle everything – including tear-out and installation, right through to the final details.
High Quality Materials

Choose from our selection of cabinetry including Pioneer, Showplace, Wood-Mode, and others, featuring a selection of woods, finishes, door styles, features and price points. Find the perfect look for your kitchen remodeling or bath remodeling project.

Exceptional Customer Service
We’re fair, honest and hardworking. We hold ourselves to a high standard following our Christian values, and strive to uphold a strong work ethic. We are professional and courteous. We collaborate and communicate. We focus on the details and on listening to our clients. We keep our promises and meet our deadlines.

What’s our favorite part of the job? Connecting with people and educating them on how a renovation can change the way they use – and feel about – their home. We love sharing our creative ideas!

Ready to Explore Ideas for Your New Kitchen or Bath?

We’d love a chance to listen to your ideas, introduce you to our services and share creative solutions. We think you’ll like doing business with us.

KITCHEN REMODELING
At MJ Kitchen & Bath, we specialize in kitchen remodeling that works for you. Your kitchen is more than just a place to cook – it’s the heart of your home, where memories are made and daily life happens.

Whether hosting family gatherings or preparing meals for two, a well-designed kitchen enhances every moment. With thoughtful planning and expert installation, your kitchen can be both beautiful and functional, tailored to your unique needs and style.​

Stop Dreaming, Start Planning!

If you’ve spent hours scrolling through Google and Pinterest or flipping through home and lifestyle magazines for kitchen design ideas, you’re not alone.

Perhaps you’re drawn to the timeless appeal of white cabinets, or you’re considering trending styles like rift cut white oak, bold navy, or soothing green. Maybe you’re dreaming of a coffee bar, a built-in wine fridge, or display cabinets to showcase your grandmother’s cherished dinnerware.

With so many possibilities, the decisions can feel overwhelming.

Partner with an Experienced Kitchen Remodeling Professional

We ask the right questions to guide you toward choices you’ll love for years to come. With in-depth product knowledge and a creative approach, we often suggest ideas you may not have considered.

Our expertise ensures you get the best value while staying within your budget. See our guide to kitchen remodel costs.

With over 30 years of experience in kitchen remodeling, MJ Kitchen & Bath will bring your dream kitchen to life.

Explore Our Kitchen Remodeling Projects
Take a closer look at some of our recent kitchen remodeling projects in Plymouth and the surrounding areas. You’ll also find examples of bath remodeling, entertainment center built-ins, basement kitchens and bars, and fireplace and staircase updates. From modern upgrades to timeless designs, our work showcases the attention to detail and craftsmanship you can expect on your project.
View full Project Portfolio
Let’s Turn Your Vision Into a Plan!

Our client-focused process: When you’re ready to take the next step we’ll schedule an in-home consultation where a member of our team will meet with you to dive into the details of your kitchen remodeling project.

During this visit, we’ll take precise measurements and share layout ideas to help you make the most of your space. We’ll listen to your ideas and explore your style.

This is also a great opportunity to refine your wish list—covering your “must-haves,” “nice-to-haves,” and those “splurge-worthy” features you’ve been dreaming about.

Following this consultation, we’ll meet with you to present a comprehensive design and initial proposal, including a detailed floor plan, perspective renderings, and a clear, written scope of work.
Once we agree to work together, we’ll refine your kitchen design and collaborate with our interior designer to finalize your finish selections. In our Plymouth Showroom, you’ll find a wide range of samples to help you visualize your new kitchen, including:

Cabinet door styles
Wood species, stain & paint colors
Countertops & backsplashes
Flooring
Plumbing fixtures & lighting
Cabinet hardware
And more!
Learn more about our process: From Start to Finish: 6 Steps to a Successful Remodel
You’ll receive color renderings to help you visualize your new kitchen. With expert guidance and hands-on selections, we’ll ensure every detail aligns with your vision.
Your Kitchen Remodel: Bringing the Plan to Life

Full project management: At MJ Kitchen & Bath, our Project Managers and Design Team expertly handle your renovation from start to finish, ensuring every detail is taken care of. We understand the importance of minimizing disruption to your daily life, so your project is carefully scheduled to balance efficiency and convenience. Most kitchen remodels are completed in 6 to 8 weeks.

Our carpentry crews will professionally install every element of your new space, from cabinets and countertops to tile, flooring, fixtures, lighting, and hardware.

With years of experience, our team has mastered the art of keeping projects on track and resolving any challenges quickly and effectively. From creating detailed construction specifications to precise product ordering, scheduling, and ensuring a perfect fit, MJ Kitchen & Bath is committed to delivering exceptional results every step of the way.


We Treat Your Home As If It Were Our Own
Remodeling can be disruptive, so we take extra steps to protect your space:

Maintaining a clean and organized job site
Sealing off adjacent rooms to minimize dust
Cleaning up at the end of each workday

Built on Trust, Striving for Excellence
You can rely on clear communication throughout your project, ensuring you’re always informed. Once the work is complete, we’ll follow up to address any questions and ensure you’re absolutely thrilled with your new kitchen.

Don’t just take our word for it…

Read Reviews
Ready to Transform Your Kitchen? Get Started Today!
When it comes to remodeling your kitchen, trust the experienced team at MJ Kitchen & Bath. We’ll collaborate with you every step of the way to design a space that’s as functional as it is beautiful—perfectly tailored to your lifestyle and vision.

Start Your Project
Planning a kitchen remodel is exciting—but it also comes with an important question: How much will my kitchen remodel cost?

At MJ Kitchen & Bath, we believe homeowners deserve straight answers, realistic expectations, ongoing communication—and quality work, done right. While every home and family is different, having a general budget range upfront helps guide smart decisions, from layout and materials to the overall scope of your project.

How Much Does a Kitchen Remodel Cost in Plymouth, Northville, Canton & Ann Arbor?
Below, you’ll find three typical levels of kitchen remodeling based on projects we’ve completed in Plymouth, Northville, Canton, Ann Arbor, Livonia, and other Metro Detroit cities. These ranges are intended as a helpful guide—not a one-size-fits-all quote. We’d love to hear more about your unique project and provide a more closely aligned estimate.
Same-Layout Kitchen Remodel
Starting at $50,000
A great option for homeowners who want an updated kitchen with minimal disruption. Focuses on functional design and fresh finishes.

Project Overview
Existing cabinet footprint remains the same

What’s Included

Cabinetry: Quality semi-custom cabinets with new hardware
Countertops: Granite or quartz (base level)
Backsplash: Tile
Plumbing: New fixtures with minimal relocation
Lighting & Electrical: Recessed lighting and new fixtures
Flooring: New snap-and-lock LVT flooring

Estimated Construction Timeline:
6+ weeks*

Expanded Kitchen Remodel
Starting at $100,000
For those ready to elevate their design and improve how their kitchen both functions and connects to the rest of the home.

Project Overview
Wall removal, expansion into adjacent living areas

What’s Included

Cabinetry: Expanded selection of semi-custom cabinets with new hardware
Wood range hood with vent
Countertops: Granite, quartz or quartzite
Backsplash: Tile or selected quartz options
Plumbing: New fixtures with minimal relocation
Lighting & Electrical: Recessed lighting, pendants, chandeliers, under-cabinet lighting, full electrical reconfiguration
Flooring: New or refinished hardwood or tile flooring in the kitchen and adjoining spaces

Estimated Construction Timeline:
8+ weeks*

First-Floor Remodel
Starting at $150,000
A comprehensive remodel combining premium materials, custom craftsmanship, unique features, potential structural changes & more.

Project Overview
Major floor plan redesign and kitchen expansion

What’s Included

Cabinetry: Fine custom cabinetry with premium features and expanded wood and finish options
Wood or metal range hood with vent
Countertops: High-end quartz or quartzite
Backsplash: Tile, quartz or quartzite
Plumbing: New fixtures with full plumbing relocation
Lighting & Electrical: Recessed lighting, designer pendants, under-cabinet lighting, full electrical reconfiguration
Flooring: New or refinished hardwood flooring throughout the first floor
Projects of this scale often include: Wet/dry bar, powder room refresh, fireplace mantel update, entertainment center

Estimated Construction Timeline:
8+ weeks*

*Project timelines are estimated from the start of construction. Permitting, material lead times, or unforeseen conditions may impact completion. All design, selections, and ordering are completed prior to construction start.

Kitchen remodel pricing can vary based on several factors, including:
Cabinet construction, materials, and finish level
Changes to layout; structural, electrical and plumbing modifications
Material selections
Age and condition of the home
Our role is to help you understand these variables clearly—so there are no surprises later. From the start, we provide realistic guidance and straightforward communication to keep your project aligned with your budget.

Take a closer look at some of our recent kitchen remodeling projects in Plymouth and the surrounding areas. You’ll also find examples of bath remodeling, entertainment center built-ins, basement kitchens and bars, and fireplace and staircase updates. From modern upgrades to timeless designs, our work showcases the attention to detail and craftsmanship you can expect on your project.

Want a clearer idea of what your kitchen remodel might cost? Schedule a consultation with MJ Kitchen & Bath to discuss your goals and explore options that fit your home and budget. Our experienced team will take the time to understand your home, your goals, and your priorities—then provide honest feedback and a realistic starting estimate. If you’re looking for quality workmanship, clear communication, and a team that follows through, we’d love to talk.

A beautiful bathroom can make all the difference in your day. Whether you’re looking to create a calm and relaxing space to unwind, update the look, or make things more practical for your daily routine, our team is here to help you make it happen with bathroom remodeling from MJ Kitchen & Bath.
Partner with an Experienced Bathroom Remodeling Professional

We know the right questions to ask to help guide your choices—so the decisions you make today are ones you’ll appreciate every day. In addition, we help you get the best value without compromising your budget, making us a trusted partner to create a space that truly enhances your home.

With in-depth product knowledge and a creative approach, we often present ideas you may not have considered.

Designed for Your Lifestyle

Update your bathroom with these sought-after features:

Showers: Curbless walk-in showers, Euro-style glass doors, rain showerheads, handheld sprayers and body jets for an invigorating experience, built-in benches, storage niches
Bathtubs: Freestanding soaking tubs for ultimate relaxation
Flooring: Radiant-heat flooring for warmth and comfort
Storage & Vanities: vanities & linen cabinets, makeup stations, convenient pull-out storage with options for hot blow dryers and curling irons, hampers and more
Our experience includes master bathrooms, guest/powder baths, Jack-and-Jill layouts, and high-traffic family bathrooms.

Explore Our Bathroom Remodeling Projects
Get inspired by our recent bathroom remodeling projects. Each project reflects our dedication to craftsmanship, attention to detail, and personalized service.
View full Project Portfolio
Let’s Turn Your Vision Into a Plan!

Our client-focused process: When you’re ready to move forward, we’ll schedule an in-home consultation to explore your bathroom remodel in detail.

During this visit, we’ll take precise measurements and discuss creative ways to maximize your space. Whether you’re refreshing an outdated master bath, replacing a bulky platform tub with a modern freestanding model, or enhancing accessibility with a walk-in shower, we’ll guide you through the best options for your needs.

Following this consultation, we’ll present a comprehensive design and proposal, including:

A detailed floor plan
Perspective drawings
A comprehensive, clear, written estimate
Once we agree to work together, we’ll refine your bathroom design and collaborate with our interior designer to finalize your finish selections:

Vanity styles & finishes (Pioneer Cabinetry, Showplace Cabinetry)
Quartz & granite countertops
Tile
Premium plumbing & lighting fixtures
Custom storage solutions
You’ll receive a color rendering to help you visualize your new bathroom, and you’ll find a wide range of samples in our Plymouth Showroom.
Bringing Your New Bathroom to Life

Full Project Management & Expert Installation: From demolition to the final finishing touches, our team handles every aspect of your renovation. Our experienced crews expertly install your vanity, shower, tub, tile, flooring, and fixtures with precision and care. Most bath remodels are completed in 3 to 6 weeks.

Enjoy a stress-free remodeling experience with a team that keeps your project on track and handles any unexpected challenges along the way. From start to finish, every detail is managed with care to ensure your new space is completed on time and to the highest standards.

We Treat Your Home As If It Were Our Own
Remodeling can be disruptive, so we take extra steps to protect your space:

Maintaining a clean and organized job site
Sealing off adjacent rooms to minimize dust
Cleaning up at the end of each workday

You can rely on clear communication throughout your project, ensuring you’re always informed. Once the work is complete, we’ll follow up to address any questions and ensure you’re absolutely thrilled with your new bathroom.

OUR REMODELING PROCESS
From Start to Finish: 6 Steps to a Successful Remodel
You can expect every step of your remodeling project with MJ Kitchen & Bath—from initial design to final completion—handled with care to provide a seamless and stress-free experience. Our remodeling process prioritizes clear communication and exceptional craftsmanship to ensure your project runs smoothly and exceeds your expectations.

16


	
STEP 1
Fast Initial Response

Start your project effortlessly: Fill out our quick inquiry form, and our team will reach out to further review your project details, provide an initial ballpark estimate, and outline next steps.

5


	
STEP 2
In-Home Consultation

We’ll visit your home to dive deeper into your project, take precise measurements, and share layout ideas to maximize your space. We’ll listen to your vision and explore your style to create a design that fits your needs and preferences.

8


	
STEP 3
Design & Proposal

Receive a comprehensive design package, including floor plans, elevation drawings, and a detailed scope of work. We’ll meet with you in our Showroom to review the plan and present a clear, transparent estimate to align with your budget and goals.

When you’re ready to commit to the project, we’ll review any revisions you’d like to make to the layout, discuss the timeline, collect a small deposit and go over the payment schedule. We strive to ensure all expectations are set for a smooth experience.

4


	
STEP 4
Selection Meeting & Finalize Design

Work with our interior designer to choose cabinet styles, countertops, backsplash tiles, flooring, hardware, and more. Our Plymouth showroom offers a wide range of samples to help you coordinate finishes. In addition, our design team will provide color renderings showing your selections to help you further visualize your new kitchen or bath.

Now’s also the time to fine-tune your project with all your “must-haves,” “should-haves” and “nice-to-haves.” Consider adding convenient cabinet accessories, review molding styles, and work with our team to nail down the details that will make your kitchen or bath work beautifully for you and your family.

5


	
STEP 5
Pre-Construction & Construction

In the weeks ahead of construction, our team is hard at work securing permits, obtaining structural engineering plans (if needed), and ordering materials to keep your project on track.

During the construction phase your designated Project Manager and skilled crew will manage every detail, demolition to installation: from cabinets and countertops, to flooring, fixtures, and more. We respect your home by keeping the job site neat, sealing off adjacent rooms to reduce dust, and cleaning up daily.

2


	
STEP 6
Wrap Up & Follow Up

Towards the end of the remodeling process, our project manager creates a punch list of any outstanding tasks. We complete these items promptly, ensuring your new space meets our quality standards and fulfills your vision.

Know that we’re always available after your project wraps up – if you have questions, need advice, or just want to share how much you’re enjoying your new space. We truly value the lasting connections we build with our clients.

Get Started Today!
We’re excited to hear about your remodeling plans and would love the chance to share more about our remodeling process, what we offer, and how we can help. Let’s connect and see if we’re the right fit for your project.

MJ Kitchen & Bath is a family-owned company committed to doing honest work, done well, for the people we serve. We guide homeowners through the remodeling process with clarity and intention, making it feel manageable instead of overwhelming. Over the years, our greatest accomplishment has been the trust and relationships we’ve built along the way.
Our Core Focus: Cultivating goodness amongst our team, our customers, and everyone around us—because we believe the way we work matters just as much as the finished result.
ABOUT MJ KITCHEN & BATH
At a Glance

MJ Kitchen & Bath is located in Plymouth, Michigan. We specialize in kitchen and bathroom design and remodeling, offering quality cabinetry and products from leading manufacturers. We serve homeowners in Plymouth, Canton, Northville, Ann Arbor and the surrounding communities.

More Than 30 Years of Experience

Owner Michael Jenkins has worked in the cabinetry industry for more than 30 years. Fulfilling his dream of becoming an entrepreneur, Mike opened MJ Cabinet Designs in 2009. The company got its start working with local builders helping them create luxury custom kitchens and baths for our clients.

“Our building trade partnerships are still important to us. We’ve worked hard to develop them and work hard to maintain them,” Mike explains.

“Looking to offer more to our retail customers, our services have grown to include start-to-finish kitchen and bath remodeling services available directly to homeowners,” he continues. “And in December 2019, we changed our name to MJ Kitchen & Bath to better reflect our expanded services.”

In the spring of 2017, we opened our showroom in the Riverbank Square shopping plaza on Ann Arbor Road in Plymouth, and expanded it in 2020 and again in 2022.

In June of 2026, we opened a new, larger showroom across the street at 620 Ann Arbor Road. The new space has allowed us to create an entirely fresh showroom experience designed to better inspire and support our clients’ remodeling journey.

Family Values

MJ Kitchen & Bath is a two-generation family-run business, with family members each playing an important role in our team. We also consider our designers, installation carpenters, and staff an integral part of the MJ Kitchen & Bath family.

Each of our employees upholds our values and acts with integrity, courtesy and professionalism on each and every project.

MJ Kitchen & Bath: Our Commitment to You

Planning a kitchen or bath makeover is exciting and the results will be enjoyed for years to come. We’ve Moved! Learn About Our New Plymouth Showroom
THE JOURNEY
Expansive Showroom
We purchased the building in Fall 2025 and the transformation is well underway. This isn’t just a refresh — it’s a full remodel of our own, taking it all the way down to the studs and rebuilding a truly unique, home-like showroom experience. The interior is being completely reimagined, and exterior updates are coming soon. Every detail is being thoughtfully planned to create a welcoming, idea-filled space where you can explore the latest in kitchen and bath design.

The new showroom will feature all-new kitchen and bath displays showcasing beautiful Wood-Mode Fine Custom Cabinetry, Showplace Cabinetry, and Pioneer Cabinetry. We’re incorporating the latest trends in colors, finishes, and materials — along with some creative concepts we can’t wait to reveal — to help spark ideas for your own home.

A Comprehensive Design Center – Making Design Decisions Easier
Our new showroom will also feature a comprehensive design center, bringing everything you need for your remodel together in one place. You’ll be able to explore cabinet materials and finishes, tile, quartz and granite countertops, flooring, hardware, and more — all thoughtfully organized to make the selection process easier. Having these elements side-by-side allows you to compare options, coordinate colors and textures, and make confident decisions, helping create a simpler, more streamlined, and enjoyable design experience.
We invite you to follow along as the Showroom transformation takes shape. We’ll be sharing progress updates – newest to oldest – plus behind-the-scenes glimpses, and hints about a few delightful surprises we have planned for the space. Stay tuned — we’re excited to bring you along for the journey!
6.29.26
Our new Showroom is now open!
We’re excited to share some big news — MJ Kitchen & Bath has moved!
We have relocated to our brand-new showroom at 620 Ann Arbor Road in Plymouth, directly across the street from old location.

While the address has changed only slightly, the new space has allowed us to create an entirely fresh showroom experience designed to better inspire and support our clients’ remodeling journey.

6.15.26
Things are moving quickly at our new showroom! While we’re not ready to unveil the full picture quite yet, we thought we’d share a few glimpses of the progress—from a stunning new display kitchen to tile details, to a moody fireplace, along with exterior updates-in-process. There’s still much more to come, and we can’t wait to show you what’s next.
4.17.26
Our display cabinets are going in at the new showroom: Here’s a quick sneak peek… stay tuned for the final reveals very soon! We can’t wait to show you how everything comes together.

Huge shoutout to all of our team members and subcontractors who have worked so hard on every step of this project – from the planning and prep, to the demo, rebuild, and now installation – we couldn’t have done this without our rockstar team!

3.30.26
Deliveries are starting to roll in at the new showroom! We’re so excited to start installing our new displays over the next several weeks and see each space come to life.
3.12.26
Time for floor tile at the new showroom!
2.25.26
We’re ready for drywall! From the concrete floor to framed walls, plumbing, and electrical – it’s been so exciting to see this space transform!
1.19.26
Big things are happening behind the scenes! Renovations are underway at our new showroom, with new walls going up for office spaces, brand-new displays, and a Design Center – where clients will soon bring their dream kitchens and baths to life.

Meanwhile, back at our current showroom, owners Mike & Matt are having some “selection meetings” of their own with our designers, choosing the perfect combination of cabinetry, hardware, and tile for our upcoming displays. We can’t wait to see it all come together!

11.14.25
It’s official: Our New Home! The sign in the photo is digitally added (renovations haven’t begun just yet), but big changes are coming as we dive into our own remodeling project. Our future home will offer a larger showroom with all-new kitchen and bath displays, an expanded selection center, and a beautifully refreshed exterior.

Look for our Grand Opening in Summer 2026 — we can’t wait to welcome you to our new home!

MJ Kitchen & Bath is a growing residential kitchen and bath retailer and remodeling company based in Plymouth, Michigan.

striving for continuous improvement
providing an unforgettable experience for our clients
supporting our employees to develop their skills

Love Others, Do the Right Thing, Be Humble, Get ‘Er Done.

Full remodeling tasks including demo, high-quality cabinet installation, drywall, and trim for
a flawless finished product

2+ years of experience in carpentry or remodeling

Ability to read and execute job site plans

loving people at every step. Our core values and culture of hospitality guide us in how we work, how
we serve and how we celebrate. If you want to make an impact while working where teammates
rally around one another, this could be a perfect fit.

We would love to meet you! Please send your resume and a brief email telling us why you believe MJ Kitchen & Bath is the right place for you to asimkins@mj-kitchens.com .

Start Your Project
KITCHEN REMODELING
At MJ Kitchen & Bath, we specialize in kitchen remodeling that works for you. Your kitchen is more than just a place to cook – it’s the heart of your home, where memories are made and daily life happens.

Whether hosting family gatherings or preparing meals for two, a well-designed kitchen enhances every moment. With thoughtful planning and expert installation, your kitchen can be both beautiful and functional, tailored to your unique needs and style.​

Stop Dreaming, Start Planning!

If you’ve spent hours scrolling through Google and Pinterest or flipping through home and lifestyle magazines for kitchen design ideas, you’re not alone.

Perhaps you’re drawn to the timeless appeal of white cabinets, or you’re considering trending styles like rift cut white oak, bold navy, or soothing green. Maybe you’re dreaming of a coffee bar, a built-in wine fridge, or display cabinets to showcase your grandmother’s cherished dinnerware.

With so many possibilities, the decisions can feel overwhelming.

Partner with an Experienced Kitchen Remodeling Professional

We ask the right questions to guide you toward choices you’ll love for years to come. With in-depth product knowledge and a creative approach, we often suggest ideas you may not have considered.

Our expertise ensures you get the best value while staying within your budget. See our guide to kitchen remodel costs.

With over 30 years of experience in kitchen remodeling, MJ Kitchen & Bath will bring your dream kitchen to life.

Explore Our Kitchen Remodeling Projects
Take a closer look at some of our recent kitchen remodeling projects in Plymouth and the surrounding areas. You’ll also find examples of bath remodeling, entertainment center built-ins, basement kitchens and bars, and fireplace and staircase updates. From modern upgrades to timeless designs, our work showcases the attention to detail and craftsmanship you can expect on your project.
View full Project Portfolio
Let’s Turn Your Vision Into a Plan!

Our client-focused process: When you’re ready to take the next step we’ll schedule an in-home consultation where a member of our team will meet with you to dive into the details of your kitchen remodeling project.

During this visit, we’ll take precise measurements and share layout ideas to help you make the most of your space. We’ll listen to your ideas and explore your style.

This is also a great opportunity to refine your wish list—covering your “must-haves,” “nice-to-haves,” and those “splurge-worthy” features you’ve been dreaming about.

Following this consultation, we’ll meet with you to present a comprehensive design and initial proposal, including a detailed floor plan, perspective renderings, and a clear, written scope of work.
Once we agree to work together, we’ll refine your kitchen design and collaborate with our interior designer to finalize your finish selections. In our Plymouth Showroom, you’ll find a wide range of samples to help you visualize your new kitchen, including:

Cabinet door styles
Wood species, stain & paint colors
Countertops & backsplashes
Flooring
Plumbing fixtures & lighting
Cabinet hardware
And more!
Learn more about our process: From Start to Finish: 6 Steps to a Successful Remodel
You’ll receive color renderings to help you visualize your new kitchen. With expert guidance and hands-on selections, we’ll ensure every detail aligns with your vision.
Your Kitchen Remodel: Bringing the Plan to Life

Full project management: At MJ Kitchen & Bath, our Project Managers and Design Team expertly handle your renovation from start to finish, ensuring every detail is taken care of. We understand the importance of minimizing disruption to your daily life, so your project is carefully scheduled to balance efficiency and convenience. Most kitchen remodels are completed in 6 to 8 weeks.

Our carpentry crews will professionally install every element of your new space, from cabinets and countertops to tile, flooring, fixtures, lighting, and hardware.

With years of experience, our team has mastered the art of keeping projects on track and resolving any challenges quickly and effectively. From creating detailed construction specifications to precise product ordering, scheduling, and ensuring a perfect fit, MJ Kitchen & Bath is committed to delivering exceptional results every step of the way.


We Treat Your Home As If It Were Our Own
Remodeling can be disruptive, so we take extra steps to protect your space:

Maintaining a clean and organized job site
Sealing off adjacent rooms to minimize dust
Cleaning up at the end of each workday

Built on Trust, Striving for Excellence
You can rely on clear communication throughout your project, ensuring you’re always informed. Once the work is complete, we’ll follow up to address any questions and ensure you’re absolutely thrilled with your new kitchen.

Don’t just take our word for it…

Read Reviews
Ready to Transform Your Kitchen? Get Started Today!
When it comes to remodeling your kitchen, trust the experienced team at MJ Kitchen & Bath. We’ll collaborate with you every step of the way to design a space that’s as functional as it is beautiful—perfectly tailored to your lifestyle and vision.

Learning from the Best: Matt Jenkins Named a Finalist for National Remodelers Award
At MJ Kitchen & Bath, we believe that doing great work for our clients means never stopping the process of learning and improving. Recently, that commitment led to a meaningful opportunity for our owner Matt Jenkins.

Matt was incredibly honored to be named a finalist for the 2025 Fred Case Award, an annual recognition that celebrates remodelers who “demonstrate entrepreneurial spirit, creativity, and dedication to innovation in the remodeling industry.” The award is named after Fred Case, founder of CASE Architects & Remodelers.

Being included among this group of finalists is humbling. The real win was the opportunity to learn from a company that lives out the spirit of this award every day.

Left to right: Mike Jenkins, Joe Chavey, Bruce Case (president and CEO of CASE), Bill Millholland (executive vice president of CASE), Matt Jenkins, Matt Quinn
The group takes a break from formal presentations to socialize and share ideas about running a remodeling business.
A Day of Collaboration & Learning
In January 2026, a small team from MJ Kitchen & Bath including Matt Jenkins, Mike Jenkins, Joe Chavey and Matt Quinn, along with the two other award finalists, were invited to visit the CASE Architects & Remodelers office in Bethesda, Maryland. The gathering brought together remodeling leaders from around the country for a day focused on learning, collaboration, and sharing ideas about how to run stronger businesses.

The event gave finalists an inside look at how one of the country’s leading remodeling firms operates.

The day included presentations on a range of topics from marketing to project management, along with open discussions about what works—and what doesn’t—when running a remodeling company.

An article in Qualified Remodeler describing the event noted that the informal theme of the day was “constructive collaboration.” Participants shared their business approaches, strengths, and challenges with the goal of learning from one another.

As quoted in the article, one of the most meaningful aspects of the experience for Matt was seeing how a strong culture and clear systems can support creativity and quality work:

“What stood out most to me was that CASE truly empowers creative people to do creative things,” Matt said. “There is a clear level of trust that allows team members to make decisions and follow their instincts, all within well-defined systems and processes that support consistency and excellence.”
The conversations throughout the day reinforced the idea that successful remodeling companies don’t stop evolving. Instead, they continually refine how they communicate with clients, manage projects, and support their teams.
Why Experiences Like This Matter to Our Clients
Opportunities like this are valuable not just for us as business owners—but ultimately for the homeowners we serve.

By connecting with other experienced remodelers and sharing ideas openly, we can learn new ways to improve communication, refine processes, and deliver better project experiences.

Bruce Case captured this spirit of collaboration during the event: “We are all working to raise the bar for our businesses, and sharing best practices openly is one of the most powerful ways to do that… Bringing finalists together creates an environment where learning is mutual, inspiration flows naturally, and everyone walks away better equipped to take their company to the next level.”

For Matt—and the whole team at MJ Kitchen & Bath—this recognition means a lot to us—not just because of the award itself, but because it celebrates the values we care deeply about: listening well, continually improving, and building meaningful relationships with both our our team and with the homeowners who trust us with their homes.

Mike Jenkins and the MJ team enjoyed a tour of the CASE offices just outside of Washington, DC.
Continuing to Learn & Improve
The visit also included a tour of the CASE offices and time spent connecting with architects, designers, and team members throughout the company who continually strive to keep raising the standard for the industry.

For us, the experience was a reminder that the best remodeling companies never stop learning. By studying what works, sharing ideas with peers, and refining how we operate, we’re better equipped to guide our clients through successful remodeling projects.

The people at CASE were incredibly generous in sharing their time, knowledge and experience with us.

A huge thank you to Bruce, Bill, and the entire Case team for their hospitality and insight! We returned home inspired, grateful, and excited for what’s ahead!

What You Need To Know About Kitchen Remodeling

A kitchen remodel is a major project, and the decisions you make early on will impact everything from cost to how your space functions day-to-day. Working with an experienced contractor helps you avoid costly mistakes, set realistic expectations, and make smarter choices throughout the process.

1.
Layout Matters More Than Anything

Your kitchen layout has the biggest impact on how the space feels and functions. Getting this right from the start is critical — a poor layout can make even a brand new kitchen frustrating to use.

2.
Moving Plumbing Increases Cost

Keeping sinks, dishwashers, and plumbing in their existing locations controls your budget. Relocating them adds labor, materials, and complexity — it should be a deliberate decision.

3.
Lighting Affects Both Function & Appearance

Good lighting makes a kitchen easier to work in and highlights the quality of your finishes. Under-cabinet, task, and overhead lighting all play a role — poor lighting can take away from an otherwise great remodel.

4.
Material Choices Drive Your Budget

Cabinets, countertops, flooring, and finishes significantly impact total cost. Finding the right balance between quality, durability, and budget is key — we'll help you make smart choices.

Remodeling your kitchen is a big decision but it's a very rewarding upgrade for your home.  A remodel will improve how you use your kitchen and your long-term resale value. But understanding how much it costs can feel overwhelming and a little confusing. That's why we created this kitchen remodeling pricing guide.  This guide was written for Santa Clarita and Southern California homeowners so they can plan smarter and avoid budget surprises.

Whether you're doing a simple and modern refresh or a full custom kitchen renovation, this guide outlines realistic kitchen remodeling costs in 2026.  Learn about the common upgrades, and even average local permit fees.

Why setting a realistic budget matters

Your budget doesn’t just control what you spend it shapes every decision you make. We help clients prioritize upgrades that actually improve how they use and enjoy the space, not just how it looks.

One recent Santa Clarita homeowner came to us unsure whether a $40K budget would get them the layout change they wanted. Turns out, it could, with smart design, semi-custom cabinetry, and value-conscious selections that didn’t cut corners. That’s the power of planning with the right contractor.

Whole Remodeling Projects In Santa Clarita CA

When it comes to remodeling an entire home, whether it's a fixer-upper, a real estate flip, or modernizing an older home in Southern California, there are several key aspects to consider:

1. Comprehensive Planning: Whole home remodeling is a substantial project. Therefore, meticulous planning is essential, encompassing everything from design, budgeting, to timelines. Detailed schematics and strategies facilitate a seamless remodeling process and mitigate the risk of unexpected expenses.

2. Understanding Local Regulations: California has particular building codes and stipulations that you must comply with, especially concerning older homes. It's advisable to become acquainted with these regulations, or even better, collaborate with a proven local contractor, like All Exclusive Construction, knowledgeable about these rules.

3. Structural Evaluation: Vintage homes might harbor structural challenges that need attention. A comprehensive assessment by a specialist can reveal potential concerns such as foundation flaws, pest damage, or antiquated electrical or plumbing infrastructures.

4. Energy Efficiency: Integrate energy-efficient enhancements during your remodel. Incorporating Energy Star-certified windows, doors, and devices, or bolstering insulation, can notably diminish energy expenditures, particularly beneficial in California's climate.

5. Design Consistency: A whole home remodel provides the opportunity to cultivate a coherent ambiance across all spaces. Reflect on the overarching design narrative and guarantee your design selections are consistent throughout the residence.

6. Resale Value: If your aim is to resell the property, ponder its potential resale worth. Prioritize investments that amplify house value, like modernizing kitchens and bathrooms, refreshing flooring, or creating inviting outdoor spaces.

7. Expert Assistance: Executing a whole home remodel is a daunting venture. Partnering with a seasoned team like All Exclusive Construction ensures adept project management, insightful design advice, and a remodel that aligns with your aspirations, financial plan, and schedule.

Remember, every home and every remodel is unique. It's a journey that should reflect your personal style, meet your living needs, and improve the overall functionality of the home. With careful planning and the right professional team, you can transform a fixer-upper or outdated property into a beautiful, modern home.

We champion a holistic approach, prioritizing design consistency to create harmonious interiors, while also keeping an eye on potential resale value, ensuring every renovation enhances your home's worth.

Energy efficiency and modern living standards are at the forefront of our practice. Our design prowess integrates state-of-the-art solutions that not only elevate aesthetics but also promote sustainability. With All Exclusive Construction, you're not just opting for a remodel; you're choosing an experienced team that values transparency, quality, and your satisfaction above all else. Entrust your home to us, and watch as we meticulously transform it into the sanctuary you've always envisioned.

To schedule a design consultation and estimate for your whole home remodeling project please call (818) 836-1722 or fill out our contact form and we'll get right back to you.

Whole Home Remodeling Projects

There are many reasons you might want to remodel your entire home

Modernizing an Outdated Home: Many older homes have charming architectural details but may lack modern conveniences. A whole home remodel can bring these homes up-to-date with the latest appliances, technologies, and energy-efficient upgrades, while preserving the character that makes them unique.

Improving Functionality: As families grow and lifestyles change, so do the needs for your living space. A whole home remodel can reconfigure your layout to improve traffic flow, increase storage, or create new spaces for home offices, fitness rooms, or other needs.

Fixing a Fixer-Upper: Buying a fixer-upper can be a more affordable way to own a home, especially in competitive markets. These homes often require significant remodeling, but with the right upgrades, they can become comfortable, personalized homes.

Real Estate Flipping: For those in the business of real estate flipping, a whole home remodel is a necessary investment. Improvements such as modern kitchens, updated bathrooms, and open concept living areas can dramatically increase the home's market value, leading to profitable returns.

Creating a Dream Home: If you love your location but not your home, a whole home remodel can transform your existing house into your dream home, designed to your exact specifications and preferences.

Preparing for Retirement: For those looking to age in place, a whole home remodel can make a home more accessible with features such as single-level living, wider doorways, or walk-in showers.

Investment Properties: For rental or Airbnb properties, a remodel can help attract tenants or guests and command higher rental prices. It can also increase the property's overall value if you decide to sell in the future.

Improving Energy Efficiency: Older homes can be energy hogs. A whole home remodel can address this by adding insulation, replacing windows and doors, and upgrading to energy-efficient appliances and systems.

Addressing Structural Issues: Over time, homes can develop structural problems that need to be addressed, such as foundation issues, roof leaks, or outdated electrical or plumbing systems. A whole home remodel allows these problems to be fixed, ensuring the safety and longevity of the home.

Enhancing Curb Appeal: First impressions matter, and a whole home remodel can dramatically improve a home's exterior aesthetics, boosting its curb appeal and market value.
